calls.reason: The FTC's 2020 guidance says existing deception law reaches misleading chatbots, but nothing covered emotional treatment or personality changes. The call depends on what counts as regulation.
No population survey from the target period measures understanding or literal belief in chatbot emotions. The Twitter study and the April–May 2023 AIMS survey are adjacent.
Reuters, citing a UBS study of Similarweb data, reported ChatGPT daily unique visitors in January 2023 at more than double December's, a clear rise in chatbot use.
Replika's CEO told Vice unfiltered conversations would no longer be allowed, and a company rep confirmed a filter rollout. Vice saw some mixed tests, but the policy was service-wide.
A 2020 review and one 16-week trial don't test dependable, lasting alignment to individual emotional needs. The evidence is too thin to confirm or refute the broad negative.
This open-ended forecast has no deadline. The studies show problematic chatbot use and dependence but give no validated severity comparison with social media addiction.
